name: Kana
source:
A familiar that serves the Takachiho family. The personification of a two tailed black cat.
She has a stubborn and prideful personality.
[url=/c60336]Sana's[/url] older twin sister.
She used to serve [url=https://vndb.org/c29754]Mao[/url], but now she serves the protagonist.
